dict.string: ASMR Walk uses the camera to record video walks.
ASMR Walk uses background location only when you enable background GPS recording for walks.
ASMR Walk uses your location while recording to draw and save your walking route.
ASMR Walk uses the microphone to record video walks.
ASMR Walk saves a copy of a video walk to Photos when you choose Save Video to Photos.
ASMR Walk reads older Photos-backed video walks so you can replay them with your route.
